title: 3640. Trionic Array II

examples.explanation: Pick l = 1, p = 2, q = 3, r = 5: nums[l...p] = nums[1...2] = [-2, -1] is strictly increasing (-2 < -1). nums[p...q] = nums[2...3] = [-1, -3] is strictly decreasing (-1 > -3) nums[q...r] = nums[3...5] = [-3, 0, 2] is strictly increasing (-3 < 0 < 2). Sum = (-2) + (-1) + (-3) + 0 + 2 = -4.

Pick l = 0, p = 1, q = 2, r = 3: nums[l...p] = nums[0...1] = [1, 4] is strictly increasing (1 < 4). nums[p...q] = nums[1...2] = [4, 2] is strictly decreasing (4 > 2). nums[q...r] = nums[2...3] = [2, 7] is strictly increasing (2 < 7). Sum = 1 + 4 + 2 + 7 = 14.
